bank_bics.description: The BIC of the bank of each line Fyniq could not derive it for (the line's ID to an 8 or 11 character BIC). Fyniq looks a BIC up from the bank code Nemura sends; a code it does not know needs a person to fill it in here, from the bank's own advice. Each becomes a new version of the line, so an earlier approval is stale.

method.description: FAST pays within minutes, up to the bank's limit; GIRO over the next working days.

money_account_id.description: The SGD bank account the batch is paid from: the chart's money account.

payment_date.description: The day the bank pays it.
